page.overview:
Who is Buna?

Buna became the apprentice of Shimeji, having been mesmerised by his gardening skills and wants to be the best gardener in the world.

Buna has black eyes and a head of spiky blond hair. He wears a simple, high-collared green kimono with white trimmings.

Riichi believed he fit the description of a "fool-faced blondie" around Sasuke Uchiha's age, which mislead Sasuke when he was trying to find Naruto.
